text: General Safety and Warnings Following are the safety measures and warnings which makes your ride safe and secure. Ensure to refer and adhere to the safety information before using the vehicle. 3.1 User Safety List of safety instructions that the user should follow, failing which can result in serious injury or death to the user and serious damage to the vehicle. - Make sure to do several laps in a safe place to get familiar with the vehicle. - Always wear a helmet and ensure that you use a helmet that is at least ISI certified. - Always plug in or plug out the power cords only when the power is switched 'OFF’. - In the absence of adult supervision, keep the charging port away from children. - Incorrect or misused connections to the battery charger may damage the equipment or put the user in a hazardous condition. - Make sure that you and the pillion rider are properly seated before starting the ride. - Do not use a mobile phone while driving, as it may disturb your attention. simpleenergy.in 17

title: simple_one_gen2_owners_manual
text: General Safety and Warnings 3.4. Thermal Runaway If a thermal runaway occurs, the entire screen turns red with white warning messaging, accompanied by a warning buzzer audio alarm on the Instrument Cluster Assembly. - During such events stop the scooter at safe location and step away from the scooter to a safe distance. - Do not try to intervene with the scooter to stop the smoke or fire. - Do not use any sort of liquids (water) to stop the fire as it may lead to the risk of explosion. simpleenergy.in 20

title: simple_one_gen2_owners_manual
text: The ‘Simple One’ is a game-changing electric vehicle that has been specifically designed and manufactured in India. With its sleek design and superior performance, the ‘Simple One’ is the perfect choice for anyone who wants to drive an affordable, yet high-quality EV. The Simple One comes in nine different colour variations, including Brazen Black, Sonic Red, Azure Blue, Grace White, Aero Gray, Brazen X, Light X, Aero X and Asphalt X, allowing users to choose the one that suits their style. One of the key features of the Simple One is its advanced electric motor, designed to perform optimally in the conditions of Indian roads. The Simple One is available a 5 kWh battery variant delivering a higher peak power of 8.8 kW. powered by a robust and highly efficient lithium-ion battery, which has been engineered to deliver long-lasting performance, making it ideal for daily commutes and longer journeys. In addition to its impressive performance, the Simple One also features a CBS brake that has been designed to provide a sporty dynamic experience. This advanced brake system ensures that the vehicle can stop quickly and smoothly, even at high speeds, providing an added level of safety and peace of mind. simpleenergy.in 22

title: simple_one_gen2_owners_manual
text: Another great feature of the Simple One is its spacious 35 L under-seat storage, which provides ample space for storing personal belongings. Whether you need to carry a laptop, a gym bag, or groceries, the ‘Simple One’ has you covered. Overall, the Simple One is an excellent choice for anyone who wants to drive a premium and sustainable electric vehicle that is built to last. With its advanced features, impressive performance, and sleek design, the Simple One is the perfect choice for anyone who wants to make a positive impact on the environment without sacrificing quality or style. 4.1. text: Maintenance Schedule - Each service interval will be at 5000 kms or 6 Months whichever is earlier. - R- Replace, I - Inspect, A- Adjust, C - Clean, TU - Top Up - Reset service reminder and check for DTCs using diagnostic tools and correct it if any at every service. - Test ride the vehicle and ascertain smooth functioning of all controls and parts. - Clean the vehicle before delivery. - *Fork oil to be replaced at every 20000 km. - **Tyre replacement to be done based on tyre wear indicator. 10.2. Service Schedule - Ensure that the charging flap is closed, and the key is removed from the vehicle. - Cover the speakers to prevent water damage and pocket filling with water. - Apply soap solution only by spraying it onto the vehicle surface. - Clean with water but avoid using a water jet above the vehicle's headlight level. - Tilt the vehicle 45° left and right to drain any collected water in the footrest

title: simple_one_gen2_owners_manual
text: a water jet above the vehicle's headlight level. - Tilt the vehicle 45° left and right to drain any collected water in the footrest and inside handlebars. - Once it is almost dry, wipe it with a soft microfibre cloth to remove any water stains. - Allow the vehicle to sun dry for 15 minutes after washing, and do not use it for 30 minutes to allow it to completely dry. simpleenergy.in 91

title: simple_one_gen2_owners_manual
text: Maintenance Schedule - To protect the 'Simple One' scooter from long-term damage due to exposure, it is important to wash it regularly. - Metal parts cleaning : Use Isopropyl alcohol (IPA) or hydrocarbon-based cleaners (low aromatic) - Heavy grease removal : Use Diesel or kerosene (with caution & proper ventilation) - Plastic & painted parts : Use Mild shampoo or automotive surface cleaner - Prior to washing, use a low-pressure water spray to remove any dirt that may scratch the paint. - Use one sponge to wash the body and a separate one to clean the wheels and tyres. - After washing with a cleaning solution, rinse the scooter again with a low-pressure water spray. - Avoid using high-pressure or steam jet cleaners as they can damage the paint or components of the scooter. Instead, use a water or two-wheeler washing solution. - Do not use hand soaps, dish-washing liquids, or glass cleaner fluids. simpleenergy.in 92

This document outlines the warranty provided by Simpleenergy Private Limited (‘SEPL’) concerning its ‘Simple One’ electric vehicle. The Company, while maintaining high standards in the design, development, and manufacturing of the vehicle, offers this warranty subject to the following terms and conditions: 13.1. Warranty Coverage and Duration - SEPL warrants the ‘Simple all variants' Electric Vehicle for a period of three (3) years or 30,000 kilometres, whichever occurs earlier, from the date of purchase. - Parts replaced under warranty will carry the balance of the original warranty or 90 days, whichever is longer. Covered Components : The warranty covers manufacturing defects in the following components, as determined by SEPL after inspection: ▪ Motor ▪ Battery Pack ▪ Motor Controller ▪ Charger ▪ Other electronic / mechanical components supplied by SEPL - SEP
